basic_profile.bio: I am a graduate student working towards a Master's degree in Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA). Previously, I worked for seven years in special education, which included time in an autism-focused classroom. I live in Houston and enjoy participating in local social events, which is why you might find me on subreddits like HoustonSocials and Charlottetown. I'm a night owl, so I'm typically online in the evenings after work. Currently, I'm single and focusing on my studies and career. When I'm not working or studying, I love exploring new places and engaging in discussions about educational methodologies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a background in special education, I've gained practical experience working with children with autism. This has provided me with a solid foundation in ABA principles, even before beginning my formal studies. My graduate coursework is expanding this knowledge, particularly in clinical settings. My curiosity drives me to seek advice from more experienced peers in the field, which has been invaluable in shaping my career path.
